missing.title: The site's files cannot be found.
missing.text: Unzip the whole folder first (do not open the page from inside the zip), keep the folders assets and data next to index.html, then open index.html again.
readme.first: UNZIP THE WHOLE FOLDER FIRST, then open index.html (a page opened from inside the zip cannot find its files).
readme.open: Open index.html in a web browser. The site needs no internet connection and no installation: everything it shows is in this folder.
readme.names: People are shown by their names ({people} people).
readme.pseudonyms: People are shown by pseudonyms (« Person 12 »), never by their names ({people} people).
readme.texts.none: The site carries no text: only keywords, themes and places on the map.
readme.texts.titles: The site carries the titles of the texts, not their content.
readme.texts.abstracts: The site carries the titles and abstracts of the texts, never a full text.
readme.never: It never carries a full text, an identifier or the extra columns of the people's lists.
shell.notice.names: An atlas of a scientific community, drawn from the vocabulary of its members' texts. People are named: share it with care.
shell.notice.pseudonyms: An atlas of a scientific community, drawn from the vocabulary of its members' texts. People are shown by pseudonyms.
shell.built: Built on {date}. Works without an internet connection.
kind1.projected: Placed on the finished map, without shaping it
home.search: Find a person, an organisation, a keyword or a theme
home.search.placeholder: A name, an organisation, a keyword…
map.lead: Each point is a person, a keyword or an organisation, placed by the words they use: close points use similar words.
map.label: Map of the community
map.keys: Arrows move the map, + and − zoom, 0 shows the whole map; click a point to select it.
map.panel.empty: Click a point, or a theme in the legend, to see what it is.
map.near.note: The lines join a person to the people whose vocabulary is closest to theirs, measured on all the words, not on the drawing.
map.caveat.title: About distances.
map.caveat: The map flattens many dimensions into two: nearby points share vocabulary, but a large distance on the drawing is only approximate.
keyword.used_by.one: Among the main keywords of {n} person
keyword.used_by.other: Among the main keywords of {n} people
org.position.note: The organisation is placed at the centre of its members on the map.
person.position.note: The lines lead to the closest people.
themes.lead: The themes group the keywords; each rectangle's size is its share of the vocabulary's use. Click one to go down a level.
themes.on_map.note: The theme's keywords and people are highlighted.
themes.people.note: People for whom the theme is at least a fifth of their vocabulary's use.
list.col.name: Name
about.map.title: What the map shows
about.map: Each person is described by the keywords found in their texts, weighted by how much they use them. The map places people and keywords so that those who share vocabulary end up close together.
about.distances.title: What distances mean
about.distances: Two nearby points use similar words. The drawing squeezes many dimensions into two, so a short distance is meaningful, but a long one is only a rough indication, and the directions (up, left) mean nothing.
about.near.title: Closest people
about.near: A person's closest people are computed on all the words, before the drawing: they are the most reliable measure of proximity the site shows. They may not be the nearest points on the drawing.
about.themes.title: Themes
about.themes: The keywords are grouped into themes, which may have sub-themes. A person's share of a theme is the part of their vocabulary's use that falls in it; colours follow the top-level theme.
about.contents.title: What this site holds
about.contents.pseudonyms: People are shown by pseudonyms; their names are not in the site.
about.contents.texts.none: No text: only keywords, themes and places on the map.
about.contents.texts.titles: The titles of the texts, not their content.
about.contents.texts.abstracts: The titles and abstracts of the texts.
about.contents.never: Never a full text, an identifier or the extra columns of the people's lists.
about.outline.title: World outline
about.outline: The outline of the land comes from Natural Earth (1:110m), which is in the public domain.
